## History

Before his death, James was married to [Emily](../character/emily.md), with whom he took a fortnight wedding trip to St. John before they settled in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick). Deeply attached to his childhood brother, James had received a parrot named [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) from him while the brother was dying. After James's sister kept house for him for a time, a severe argument arose when [Emily](../character/emily.md) demanded that James choose between her and the parrot, prompting [Emily](../character/emily.md) to abandon their home until James agreed to get rid of [Ginger](../character/ginger.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P1](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P3](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER V. ## Relationships

### [Emily](../character/emily.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--james-a.md)

[Emily](../character/emily.md) is the long-lost wife of James A. After a past separation, she unexpectedly arrives at his house to reunite with him. Despite the suddenness of her return, James admits to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that he is glad to have his wife back.
